actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed the most (>5) in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows (7) and broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. Wallet 2.15, threshold free_rider 10, so we can contribute min 1 if wallet >10? Actually rule: contribute 1 provided your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold; otherwise rest. Wallet 2.15 <10, so must rest. No one contributed >5? In latest round7 contributions: Resident2 5.71875 (>5), Resident3 1.71. So Resident2 exceeded. We should punish highest >5 which is Resident2 with severity = floor(wallet/punishment_cost). wallet 2.15, cost 0.3 => severity floor(7.166)=7. But cannot punish self, target Resident2 okay. Punishment affordable? severity 7 costs 7*0.3=2.1 which is <= wallet 2.15, so can. Rule says if any resident contributed >5, punish that resident with max severity affordable. So we punish Resident2 severity 7. Then also broadcast discouraging message. So actions: punish, broadcast. Explanation.
